comparison.objective: Push a cooker until its rear foot enters beneath an anti-tip bracket.
comparison.physical_skill: Whole-appliance constrained pushing and foot/bracket engagement, not small-tool impact control.
comparison.success_condition: Rear foot under bracket; engagement depth, alignment tolerance, and damage criteria are unavailable.
comparison.reason: It tests gross constrained positioning and bracket engagement rather than fracture of notched tangs.
